description: Restore explicit total-variation convention (PDF p. 17).
old: The actual law after $n$ rounds is $(P^nf_0)\gamma$ when $\mu_0=f_0\gamma$.
new:
The actual law after $n$ rounds is $(P^nf_0)\gamma$ when $\mu_0=f_0\gamma$. We use the convention
\[
 \operatorname{TV}(\mu,\nu)=\sup_B|\mu(B)-\nu(B)|=\tfrac12\|\mu-\nu\|_{\rm var},
\]
where the supremum is over Borel sets.

description: Restore exact distinction between Schwartz Lebesgue density and bounded relative density (PDF p. 18).
old: This density is normalized, strictly positive, Schwartz in physical coordinates, and bounded above and below relative to $\gamma$.
new: The probability $\mu_0$ has a normalized, strictly positive Schwartz density with respect to Lebesgue measure in physical coordinates. Its relative density $f_0$ is bounded above and below by positive constants.

description: Restore definitions of relative entropy and mutual information (PDF p. 19).
old: Measure preservation gives an exact information identity.
new: All logarithms are natural. We write $D(\mu\Vert\nu)$ for relative entropy and $I(Z;W)$ for the relative entropy of the joint law with respect to the product of its marginals. Measure preservation gives an exact information identity.

description: Restore binary entropy definition and H(C) assignment (PDF p. 20).
new: With $h_{\rm bin}(p)=-p\log p-(1-p)\log(1-p)$, each command has entropy $H(C)=h_{\rm bin}(1/4)+(3/4)\log2$
